content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-35. - Waiver of objections.
content.summary:
Any complaint, protest or objection to the regularity, validity and correctness of
               the proceedings and instruments taken, adopted or made prior to the date of a provisional
               order hearing shall be deemed waived unless presented in writing on specific grounds
            …

faqs.a:
Any complaint, protest or objection to the regularity, validity and correctness of
               the proceedings and instruments taken, adopted or made prior to the date of a provisional
               order hearing shall be deemed waived unless presented in writing on specific grounds
               at the time and in the manner herein provided.
(Code 1981, § 27-36; Ord. No. 551, § 14(E), 5-14-1964)
